Class FlatLafInstaller

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.flatlaf.FlatLafInstaller
All Implemented Interfaces:
LookAndFeelInstaller
public final class FlatLafInstaller extends Object implements LookAndFeelInstaller
Installs FlatLaf, light or dark: the be.imgn.swing.theme system property, else the theme key of the application's resources, selects system (the default), light or dark.
